verdict.rationale: Firestore documents "atomic batch operations" for writing many documents at once. The firebase-tools CLI can import and export Auth users in bulk. The official MCP server lets an AI client manage Auth users and work with Firestore data. However, each is a single-line mention, and nothing shows bulk update or delete across many items being driven from AI tooling. Missing for 10: documented batch size and limits, bulk update/delete across collections via CLI or MCP, evidence that MCP tools act on many items per call, and independent hands-on corroboration.
